tasks.title: Configure GitHub Actions staging deployment pipeline
tasks.outcome: Created and debugged .github/workflows/deploy-staging.yml. Fixed 5 issues: interactive shell requirement, docker-compose vs docker compose syntax, local image pull error, container path for alembic (/app vs /app/CODE), HEREDOC quoting issues. Final solution uses direct SSH commands. Workflow now successfully deploys on push to staging branch.
